categories.main_business_segments: YUSHIN Company operates primarily in the development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service of take-out robots for plastic injection molded products and related automation equipment. The business is organized into four geographic segments: Japan, the United States, Asia, and Europe, each responsible for sales, manufacturing, and service in their respective regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-speed, automated take-out robots for plastic injection molding, as well as peripheral automation systems. Core technologies include robotics engineering, precision mechanical design, and integration of automation solutions, with manufacturing based on advanced assembly and quality control processes, supported by ISO9001 and ISO14001 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the plastic injection molding industry, including automotive, electronics, and medical device sectors. Major end markets include industrial manufacturers seeking automation for improved productivity and labor savings, with notable clients such as Johnson & Johnson in the medical field.
categories.geographic_coverage: YUSHIN has a global footprint with operations in Japan, North America (primarily the US), Asia (including China, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and India), and Europe (notably Germany, Sweden, and the UK). Sales and service networks are established in all major industrial regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, providing automation equipment and robots to manufacturers (OEMs) for integration into their production lines, as well as offering after-sales service and parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening global sales, expanding market share in Europe via WEMO Automation AB, and enhancing product value through continuous R&D. Innovation themes focus on automation for labor savings, safety, and efficiency, with active development of new models (e.g., palletizing robots) and customization for specific industries such as medical devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of robots, custom automation equipment, and related peripheral devices, as well as after-sales services and spare parts. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance (inspection), with some contracts including installation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YUSHIN is a leading company in the take-out robot industry for injection molding, competing globally with other industrial automation and robotics firms. The market is highly competitive, with price competition and technological innovation as key factors; YUSHIN positions itself as a high-quality, reliable, and innovative provider with a strong global service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached approximately 26.1 billion yen, with operating profit of 2.59 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 1.69 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales (10.6% YoY increase), maintains a high equity ratio (85.5%), and employs around 800 people globally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YUSHIN emphasizes delivering 'progress' and 'peace of mind' to customers through high-quality, reliable automation solutions that enhance productivity and safety. Its competitive differentiation lies in its global service network, ability to customize solutions for diverse industries, and continuous innovation in robotics and automation technology.
